title: The business reflection worksheet
summary: A free, simple worksheet to record one observation, the evidence you have and what you still need to check.
author: Timothy Madu
body: Choose one customer or revenue question in your business. Record the observation first, then identify the evidence you need before deciding what to do.
This introductory worksheet is an original website resource. It is not a chapter excerpt or a validated business assessment.
